deadline.value: January 15 application deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: all of your materials must be received by the application deadline of January 15, 2027.

gre_general.value: GRE general test requirement not stated on admissions page.

gre_subject.value: Math subject GRE scores are recommended but not required.
gre_subject.quote: Math subject GRE scores are recommended but not required—the University of Oregon’s Institution Code is 4846.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 100 with at least 26 on speaking.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL internet-based test: score of 100 or better (on the 0-120 scale) or 5 or better (on the new 1-6 scale), with at least 26 (on the 0-30 scale) or 5 (on the new 1-6 scale) on the speaking section.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 7.0 overall band score.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS exam: overall band score of 7.0 or better, with at least 7.0 on the speaking band.

funding.value: All admitted doctoral students are supported by Graduate Employee positions with stipend, full tuition waiver, and health insurance.
funding.quote: all of whom are supported by Graduate Employee positions that carry a stipend, full tuition waiver, and health insurance.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree or expected attainment by end of summer required for admission.
entry_route.quote: To be considered for admission, you must have a bachelor’s degree or expect to attain one by the end of summer 2027.
